state.question: Assess Copper Storage's reported battery dispatch. I need the following measured result: Its measured September round-trip efficiency after auxiliary consumption.
state.gap: Its measured September round-trip efficiency after auxiliary consumption.
passages:
I began with the underlying record, then checked the units against the stated scope of the exercise.

Copper's settlement meters show 100 MWh charged and 84 MWh discharged in September including auxiliaries; round-trip efficiency was 84%.

Background to the observation: Copper's battery began commercial dispatch in September.

A comparison should use the same unit on both sides. A percentage-point change is different from a percentage change. A nameplate limit is also different from measured delivery under operating conditions.
